body: Locked front-on 1:1 die-cut vinyl sticker on a transparent background with a thick white border. Show a tilted brushed-silver and signal-orange cassette labeled "SIDE A". Rotate the inner reels smoothly while two cobalt music notes appear in the middle frames and clear by the final frame, which must match the clean silhouette of frame 1. Keep the label crisp.
